articles.summary: Pre-Tax Income of $29.8 million; Earnings per share1 of $0.25; Managed Premium2 of $1.4 billion Exzeo Group, Inc. (NYSE:XZO) today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. “AI will reshape the insurance industry, not just in expense ratios but in how coverage is bought and sold,” said Paresh Patel, Exzeo’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. “That creates a real opening for Exzeo to expand its revenue base by designing and deploying new offerings with carrier partners. We’re starting from a strong position: we have the team, the technology and the balance sheet to pursue this while remaining solidly profitable.” Third Quarter 2026 Highlights (Comparisons to Third Quarter 2025) Revenue was in line with the prior-year period at $55.2 million. Adjusted Revenue 3 , which excludes outsourced claims service revenue that is driven largely by catastrophe events, increased to $53.9 million from $52.4 million, due to growth in underwriting and management
articles.title: Exzeo Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
